suggestions.title: Heat
suggestions.description: A master thief and a dedicated detective develop a mutual respect as their cat-and-mouse game intensifies through the streets of Los Angeles. Michael Mann's epic heist film famously pairs Al Pacino and Robert De Niro on screen together for the first time, in a blistering crime saga capped by the legendary diner scene and a celebrated bank-heist gunfight. Tense, operatic, and endlessly rewatchable — arguably the gold standard of the Los Angeles crime thriller.

suggestions.title: Pan's Labyrinth
suggestions.description: In post-Civil War Spain, a young girl escapes the brutality of her fascist stepfather's world by retreating into a dark, mythical labyrinth where a faun claims she is a lost princess. Guillermo del Toro's Academy Award-winning masterpiece interweaves a haunting fairy tale with grim historical reality, blending stunning practical effects and genuinely frightening creatures with profound emotional depth. A singular dark-fantasy epic that is equal parts beautiful and brutal.

suggestions.title: The Shining
suggestions.description: A writer takes a winter caretaker job at an isolated mountain hotel, where his sanity rapidly unravels and his family's safety spirals into terror. Stanley Kubrick's chilling masterpiece — anchored by Jack Nicholson's iconic, unhinged performance — is a slow-burn descent into madness distinguished by its eerie symmetry, unsettling score, and half-dozen unforgettable set pieces. Widely regarded as one of the greatest and most influential horror films ever made.
